gameServerCpuCentsPerSec.what: $0.02 per million CPU milliseconds, Dynamic Workers' startup included

gameServerSessionCentsPerSession.what: $0.30 per million Dynamic Worker requests; calls on a returned RpcTarget aren't billed

loadedVersionCentsPerDay.what: $0.002 per Dynamic Worker (ID and code) a day

inboundMessageCentsPerMessage.what: $0.15 per million Durable Object requests, incoming WebSocket messages at 20 to 1

roomConnectionCentsPerConnection.what: $0.30 per million Worker requests plus $0.15 per million Durable Object requests

objectRequestCentsPerRequest.what: $0.15 per million Durable Object requests (alarms, RPC sessions)

databaseCallCentsPerCall.what: $0.15 per million Durable Object requests; the binding in front of it is a service binding, billed no request

requestCentsPerRequest.what: $0.30 per million Worker requests plus $0.15 per million Durable Object requests

relayedCentsPerByte.what: $0.05 per GB through Cloudflare's TURN relay

writtenRowCentsPerRow.what: $1 per million rows written (D1 and SQLite-backed Durable Objects)

adultChatCheckCentsPerCheck.what: One Claude Haiku check of a chat message, about 0.0024 to 0.007 cents (Oct 26, 2026), the top of that range
